verdict.rationale: Marketing copy says Better Stack plugs into Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix and the major clouds. It also claims escalation rules can branch on time, team availability and incident origin. Escalation-policy docs describe custom rules for who gets alerted and in what order. However, there are no documented integration or ingestion setup pages and no explicit docs on routing alerts to specific teams by user-defined conditions. Missing for 10: documented per-source ingestion guides (e.g., a Datadog or Prometheus alert integration page), explicit condition-based team routing documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
